intro: How much energy you put on which account, this week. Not where the deal stands, not whether you decided to work it — the third question, and the only one with a cap.

lanes.hint: Your view, not an imposed role: switch between the accounts you choose to concentrate on and those you work differently.

unplaced.title: To place
unplaced.hint: These accounts have no effort level yet. Pick where they go — nothing is placed without your action.

watchEntry.title: Put {{name}} on watch — wake condition?
watchEntry.label: Wake condition
watchEntry.placeholder: e.g. an HR signal or a funding round

page.askLauraQuestion: Arbitrate my effort allocation: which accounts to focus on, which to slow down, and why? Propose, I decide.

empty.focus: No account on high priority this week. This is where you concentrate your effort — eight at most, so that “priority” still means something.
empty.extension: No account to develop. This is for those where the relationship exists and there is still ground to take.
empty.volume: No account to qualify. This is for those you work in batches, without individual effort.
empty.no_go: No account on hold. An account only lands here with a written reason, and it only leaves with a fresh signal.
empty.watch: No account on watch. This is for accounts that are compatible but have no current reason to act — a wake condition awaits them here.
empty.partner_route: No account on the partner route. This is for accounts whose way in runs through a partner ESN rather than a direct contact.

levelMeans.focus: Accounts to concentrate your commercial effort on this week. Eight at most, to keep focus meaningful.
levelMeans.extension: The relationship exists and there is still ground to take. Steady effort, not maximum.
levelMeans.volume: Worked in batches, without individual effort — that is what keeps time for high priorities.
levelMeans.no_go: Set aside with a written reason. We do not come back without a fresh signal.
levelMeans.watch: Compatible, with no current reason to act. No energy engaged — a wake condition says when to come back.
levelMeans.partner_route: The way in runs through a partner ESN or a rank-2 relationship, not through direct effort on the account.
